rules.replied_not_fit: (unsubscribe|stop|remove me|not interested|no thanks|wrong person|already have an agency|do not contact)
rules.replied_not_now: (not right now|next quarter|next month|too busy|swamped|reach out in|check back|budget.*(tight|later|next year))

flow.name: Neon — Match SBA Prospect by Email or Last-10 Phone

parameters.sql: select p.id as prospect_id, p.dedupe_id, p.borr_name, p.airtable_record_id, p.outreach_status, p.computed_lead_score from public.sba_prospects p where ($1 <> '' and lower(btrim(coalesce(p.owner_email, ''))) = $1) or (length($2) >= 10 and (right(regexp_replace(coalesce(p.owner_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10) = right($2, 10) or right(regexp_replace(coalesce(p.google_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10) = right($2, 10))) order by p.computed_lead_score desc limit 1;

steps.name: Neon — Insert Idempotent Touch (on conflict do nothing)
steps.sql: insert into public.sba_outreach_touches (prospect_id, external_event_id, channel, direction, sequence_name, sequence_step, subject_line, message_summary, outcome, reply_sentiment, reply_excerpt, next_followup_at, occurred_at) values ($1::uuid, $2, 'inbound_reply', 'inbound', 'INBOUND_WEBHOOK', 1, $3, $4, $5::public.touch_outcome_type, $6, $7, null, $8::timestamptz) on conflict (external_event_id) do nothing returning id, prospect_id, outcome, occurred_at;

flow.name: Neon — Log Execution to automation_runs
flow.sql: insert into public.automation_runs (execution_id, client_slug, workflow_id, workflow_name, status, records_processed, error_message, execution_url) values ($1, 'coco_club_live', $2, 'wf1_inbound_reply_logger', 'success', 1, '', $3) on conflict (execution_id) do nothing;
